description: Exceptional, bounded search in exact past personal exchanges. It can verify a missing personal fact or recover a precise chronological boundary. Use only with a defensible temporal or conversational basis. Not for the web or external facts.
lookup_kind_description: `personal_fact` verifies an attributed item and first consults plausible souvenirs. `conversation_chronology` retrieves what was discussed immediately before or after a branching point and accesses the exact L0 order directly.
need_description: A single atomic personal item missing from the response, with its attribution. Split distinct needs into separate calls.
